options.text: Increased by more than 40% in 2019 as compared to 2015
Neither increased nor decreased between 2015 and 2019

solution:
**Given:**

In 5 years consumption of electricity in GW by the population in millions

**Calculation:**

In 2015 consumption of electricity per person = ((2500)/(20)) = 125 (As 1 GW = 100 Million watt)

Likewise, In 2016 consumption of electricity per person = 133.33

In 2017 consumption of electricity per person = 150

In 2018 consumption of electricity per person = 160

In 2019 consumption of electricity per person = 166.67

Since, we can see that consumption of electricity per person is increasing constantly

Now, 

**Considering option (1), **

Decreased between 2015 - 2019 → It is incorrect as we have seen above that consumption increased constantly.

**Considering option (2),**

Increased between 2015 - 2019 → It is correct as consumption increased constantly.

Now, consumption in 2015 per person = 125

Consumption in 2019 per person = 166.67

⇒ Increased in consumption = (166.67 - 125) = 41.67

⇒ Percentage = ((41.67 )/(125)) × 100 = 33.33 %

**Now, considering option (3), we have**

Increased by more than 40% in 2019 as compared to 2015 → It is incorrect as an increase is only 33.33%.

**In considering option (4), we have **

Neither increased nor decreased between 2015 - 2019 → It is incorrect as consumption per person increased by 33.3%.

**Hence, option (2), i.e. consumption of electricity per person increased between 2015 and 2019 is true.**
